==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=AngleSharp&min=AngleSharp&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.AngleSharp: compares html, htm and svg by parsing both sides and diffing the DOM, so
        // reordered attributes, reformatted markup and whitespace no longer fail a test.
        // The call is explicit because the class is named VerifyAngleSharpDiffing, and plugin discovery
        // looks for a type named after the assembly, VerifyAngleSharp, so it never finds this one.
        VerifyAngleSharpDiffing.Initialize();

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/AngleSharpTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=AngleSharp&min=AngleSharp&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using AngleSharp.Diffing;
using AngleSharp.Diffing.Core;
using VerifyTests.AngleSharp;

// Verify.AngleSharp: Compares html, htm and svg snapshots as markup rather than as text, and pretty prints them.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.AngleSharp
// Note: This plugin compares and scrubs; it never produces a new snapshot target of its own.
// Note: Pretty printing and semantic comparison are independent: either can be used without the
// other.
// Note: HtmlPrettyPrint.All() applies pretty printing to every html snapshot in the project,
// instead of per test.
public class AngleSharpTests
{
    // The extension passed to Verify decides the snapshot's file extension, and so which
    // comparer runs. This one is compared as a DOM, not as text.
    [Fact]
    public Task Html()
    {
        var html =
            """
            <!DOCTYPE html>
            <html>
              <body>
                <h1>My First Heading</h1>
                <p>My first paragraph.</p>
              </body>
            </html>
            """;
        return Verify(html, "html");
    }

    // Rendered html usually arrives as one long line, which makes a snapshot diff unreadable.
    // PrettyPrintHtml reformats it before it is written.
    [Fact]
    public Task PrettyPrint()
    {
        var html = "<html><body><h1>My First Heading</h1><p>My first paragraph.</p></body></html>";
        return Verify(html, "html")
            .PrettyPrintHtml();
    }
}

==== interactions

Info plugin-not-discovered: VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins() cannot find AngleSharp: it looks for a type named after the assembly, and silently skips an assembly that has none. The module initializer calls each of them explicitly, so they are enabled either way.
